description: Search Yedapo's 5,000+ AI summaries of podcast and YouTube episodes. Matches words in the episode title, the show name, the summary's topic tags and its short teaser text (not full transcripts). Returns up to 10 matches, newest first within each match type, each with show, date, teaser, the episode id for get_episode, and a page URL to cite. Newest summary added: 2026-11-04.
